# Module-level execution context used by lyse analysis routines. When a routine
# is run stand-alone these defaults provide the public API expected by scripts
# that do ``from lyse import *``. When run by the lyse GUI, the analysis worker
# executes the routine in this module namespace and replaces/mutates these values
# to communicate GUI state and collect results. Keep these names here for
# backwards compatibility with existing routines and with the worker's injection
# mechanism.
spinning_top = False
# data to be sent back to the lyse GUI if running within lyse
_updated_data = {}
# dictionary of plot id's to classes to use for Plot object
_plot_classes = {}
# A fake Plot object to subclass if we are not running in the GUI
Plot=object
# An empty dictionary of plots (overwritten by the analysis worker if running within lyse)
plots = {}
# A threading.Event used by the GUI worker to delay returning results
 delay_event = threading.Event()
# a flag to determine whether we should wait for the delay event
_delay_flag = False
